WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.zoneref,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(sp.remaingb) as avg_remaining_gb,
    AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) as avg_cpu_gpu_diff
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
mean_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_gb) as mean_remaining_gb
  FROM group_stats
  WHERE avg_remaining_gb IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  gs.zoneref,
  gs.insurstat,
  gs.avg_remaining_gb,
  gs.avg_cpu_gpu_diff,
  gs.avg_remaining_gb / ms.mean_remaining_gb as ratio
FROM group_stats gs
CROSS JOIN mean_stats ms
WHERE ms.mean_remaining_gb IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
